items.title: Urgent Action Required: Critical Security Update Available for Adobe Commerce (StyleSmuggler Zero-Day)
items.summary: Adobe has released an urgent security update addressing a critical zero-day vulnerability, dubbed 'StyleSmuggler', in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source that is being actively exploited in the wild. This vulnerability allows an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code on affected installations.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-92
items.summary: Adobe released a regularly scheduled security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source, resolving critical and important vulnerabilities. Successful exploitation could lead to arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB25-71
items.summary: This Adobe Security Bulletin addresses critical and important vulnerabilities in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source. Successful exploitation could result in security feature bypass, privilege escalation, arbitrary file system read, and application denial-of-service.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-73
items.summary: Adobe released a security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source, resolving critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities. Successful exploitation could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass.
